content: Dexie.js official docs (dexie.org Version.stores): schema strings declare primary key + indexes only; syntax ++ autoincrement, & unique, * multi-entry array index, [A+B] compound index, dotted paths for nested props; version() framework for migrations (add/alter/remove tables); CRITICAL WARNING: never index properties holding images/large strings/blobs - store them but do not index (large indexes degrade performance and stability); only string, number, Date and Array are indexable - NOT boolean, null, or undefined (booleans must be modeled as 0/1 or omitted from indexes); rule of thumb: only index what you query with where(). Dexie 4 is the current major; react integration via dexie-react-hooks (useLiveQuery).
